description: Tronçons de routes et ouvrages d'art interdits pour le transport de bois rond - Loire is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Section of road the use of which is prohibited or impossible for the use of vehicles of high tonnage carrying round or other timber; sections limited to 40 t. Department of Loire. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Sections of roads and works of art prohibited for the transport of roundwood — Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
